generated.details: The panel has evenly punched circular holes and folded perimeter returns secured to wall standoffs.
Behind its upper return, the concealed RGB strip sits in a recessed channel with a diffuser, casting only a low magenta-blue wall glow.
On the near-left tabletop beside the laptop, the palm-sized solid-color ivory puzzle cube has aligned interlocking sections with narrow seams and rests flat on one face.
